description: This file implements DES encryption driver functions for the Linux kernel, including setting keys, encrypting/decrypting in various modes (ECB, CBC, OFB, CFB, CTR), and registering/unregistering cryptographic algorithms. It is part of the DEU module for Infineon Technologies hardware.

methods.name: des_setkey
methods.description: Sets the DES key in the cryptographic context.

methods.name: ifx_deu_des
methods.description: Main interface to DES hardware for encryption/decryption in various modes.

methods.name: ifx_deu_des_ecb
methods.description: Configures DES hardware to ECB mode and performs encryption/decryption.

methods.name: ifx_deu_des_cbc
methods.description: Configures DES hardware to CBC mode and performs encryption/decryption.

methods.name: ifx_deu_des_ofb
methods.description: Configures DES hardware to OFB mode and performs encryption/decryption.

methods.name: ifx_deu_des_cfb
methods.description: Configures DES hardware to CFB mode and performs encryption/decryption.

methods.name: ifx_deu_des_ctr
methods.description: Configures DES hardware to CTR mode and performs encryption/decryption.

methods.name: des3_ede_setkey
methods.description: Sets the 3DES EDE key in the cryptographic context.

methods.name: ifxdeu_init_des
methods.description: Initializes the DES driver and registers algorithms.
